name: Old Fire-Eye

narrative.details:
I see that you have your weapon now, champion. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
narrative.objectives: Use the Moonsilver Blade to destroy Old-Fire Eye in Silverpine Forest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you, Quantum. Banon may now rest in peace.If you would be willing to allow it, I believe that I can impart some magic upon your freshly blooded blade to infuse it with a small measure of the magic of my people.<Lumina Windsinger's eyes begin to glow a vibrant blue as she touches the bloodstained blade in your hand.>It is done. It's a small thing, and I could scarcely improve such a magnificent blade. Regardless, I will pray to the winds that it serves you well, champion.
narrative.requestItemsText: Is it done? Is the beast slain?
